name: Gem of Brightness
description: A long prism of crystal that holds a spark at its heart.
body:
## What it does

One word makes it shed light, bright for 30 feet and dim for 30 beyond, without spending anything. With its charges it can do more.

## Charges

It holds 50 and never regains them. Spend one to fire a beam at a creature within 60 feet, which makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or is blinded for a minute. Spend five to flare in a 30-foot cone, with the same save for everyone in it. With its last charge spent, it is an ordinary gem worth 50 gp.

features.name: Beam
features.text: 1 charge: a creature within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is blinded for a minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

features.name: Flare
features.text: 5 charges: every creature in a 30-foot cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is blinded for a minute.

charges.last: it becomes an ordinary gem worth 50 gp
